verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a one-time-passcode generator (TOTP/HOTP). The evidence covers code sync, transfer, editing, search and the privacy screen. AI-generated insights from user data is not an axis a buyer would reasonably use to compare 2FA code generators, and nothing in the pack shows any AI or insights feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
